description.en: Swaps uppercase and lowercase letters.
description.ja: 大文字と小文字を入れ替える

description.en: Capitalizes only the first letter of the text and keeps all-uppercase acronyms (API, URL, etc.) intact (unlike **Change Case Sentence**, which lowercases acronyms too).
description.ja: 文頭だけを大文字にし、全大文字の略語（API・URL など）は小文字にしない（**Change Case Sentence** は略語も小文字にする）

example.en: `the API URL is ready` → `The API URL is ready`
example.ja: `the API URL is ready` → `The API URL is ready`

description.en: Converts to APA-style title case (words of four or more letters are capitalized even if they are prepositions).
description.ja: APA スタイルのタイトルケース（4 文字以上の単語は前置詞でも大文字）

example.en: `a guide through the woods` → `A Guide Through the Woods`
example.ja: `a guide through the woods` → `A Guide Through the Woods`

description.en: Uppercases only the first character and leaves the rest unchanged.
description.ja: 先頭の 1 文字だけを大文字にし、残りは変更しない

description.en: Lowercases only the first character and leaves the rest unchanged.
description.ja: 先頭の 1 文字だけを小文字にし、残りは変更しない

description.en: Converts to uppercase words separated by hyphens (COBOL-CASE).
description.ja: 大文字のハイフン区切り（COBOL-CASE）に変換する

description.en: Converts to underscore-separated words with each word capitalized (Ada\_Case).
description.ja: 各単語の先頭を大文字にしたアンダースコア区切り（Ada\_Case）に変換する

description.en: Removes separators and joins all words in lowercase (flatcase).
description.ja: 区切りを除いてすべて小文字で連結する（flatcase）

description.en: Removes separators and joins all words in uppercase (UPPERFLATCASE).
description.ja: 区切りを除いてすべて大文字で連結する（UPPERFLATCASE）

description.en: Converts to underscore-separated words with the first word lowercase and the following words capitalized (camel\_Snake).
description.ja: 先頭語は小文字、以降の語は先頭大文字のアンダースコア区切り（camel\_Snake）

description.en: Converts to underscore-separated words with each word capitalized (Pascal\_Snake).
description.ja: 各語の先頭を大文字にしたアンダースコア区切り（Pascal\_Snake）

description.en: Alternates between uppercase and lowercase word by word.
description.ja: 単語ごとに大文字・小文字を交互に切り替える

description.en: Builds an acronym by joining the uppercase initial letter of each word.
description.ja: 各単語の頭文字を大文字で連結して略語を作る

description.en: Detects the naming convention of the selected text (camel / snake / kebab, etc.) and shows it as a notification.
description.ja: 選択テキストの命名規則（camel / snake / kebab など）を判定して通知表示する

description.en: Cycles the naming convention in the order camel → snake → kebab → Pascal → CONSTANT.
description.ja: camel → snake → kebab → Pascal → CONSTANT の順に命名規則を循環させる

description.en: Uppercases only known acronyms such as id / url / http / json (the dictionary is built into the extension).
description.ja: id / url / http / json など既知の略語だけを大文字にする（辞書は拡張内に定数で持つ）

description.en: Capitalizes the first letter of each sentence delimited by ". ! ?" (unlike **Change Case Sentence**, which treats the whole text as one sentence).
description.ja: 「. ! ?」で区切られた文ごとに先頭を大文字にする（**Change Case Sentence** は全体を 1 文として扱う）

example.en: `hello. how are you? fine.` → `Hello. How are you? Fine.`
example.ja: `hello. how are you? fine.` → `Hello. How are you? Fine.`

description.en: Uppercases only the first character of each line.
description.ja: 各行の先頭文字だけを大文字にする

description.en: Lowercases only the first character of each line.
description.ja: 各行の先頭文字だけを小文字にする

description.en: Uppercases the text with toLocaleUpperCase using the locale you enter (e.g. the Turkish i).
description.ja: 入力したロケールで toLocaleUpperCase を行う（トルコ語の i など）

description.en: Lowercases the text with toLocaleLowerCase using the locale you enter.
description.ja: 入力したロケールで toLocaleLowerCase を行う

description.en: Recursively converts only the JSON keys to camelCase (values are left unchanged).
description.ja: JSON のキーだけを再帰的に camelCase にする（値は変更しない）

description.en: Recursively converts only the JSON keys to snake\_case.
description.ja: JSON のキーだけを再帰的に snake\_case にする

description.en: Recursively converts only the JSON keys to kebab-case.
description.ja: JSON のキーだけを再帰的に kebab-case にする

description.en: Recursively converts only the JSON keys to PascalCase.
description.ja: JSON のキーだけを再帰的に PascalCase にする

description.en: Converts to a CSS custom property name (--kebab-case).
description.ja: CSS カスタムプロパティ名（--kebab-case）に変換する

description.en: Converts three words to BEM notation (block\_\_element--modifier).
description.ja: 3 語を BEM 記法（block\_\_element--modifier）に変換する

description.en: Pluralizes English words using rules (with a small dictionary for irregular forms).
description.ja: 英単語を規則ベース（不規則変化は小さな辞書）で複数形にする

description.en: Singularizes English words using rules.
description.ja: 英単語を規則ベースで単数形にする

description.en: Converts to PascalCase prefixed with # (hashtag style).
description.ja: 先頭に # を付けた PascalCase（ハッシュタグ形式）に変換する
